name: crash-course
note: The Crash Course's chart palette, from the Decision Machine's tokens. paper is the print sheet a figure is drawn for (charts are written transparent); ink the main series and text; ink2 tick labels; ink3 quiet reference lines; axis the spines and ticks; grid the gridlines; accent the look-ahead green; s1 to s4 a slate ramp, darkest first by day and lightest first by night.
